description: Production-safe demo inputs for SentinelAI: two one-row event matrices selected from the HELD-OUT test split (never used for training). Intended labels are ground-truth labels (anomaly_label.csv) recorded for evaluation only — the inference pipeline never sees them and all predictions are computed live from the trained models.

split.name: test
split.strategy: grouped: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over deterministic SHA-256 group IDs of the complete feature vector; test partition = fold 0
split.guarantee: no exact feature vector appears in both train and test (overlap hard-checked to 0)

selection.method: candidates scored with the already-trained artifacts (loaded read-only, NO retraining); normal = lowest composite risk among held-out rows the classifier predicts normal; anomalous = highest composite risk among held-out rows the classifier predicts anomalous, additionally required to show HIGH/CRITICAL risk, evidence phrases and a non-empty blast radius
